mapper.sql: id, zone_code, code, name, coordinate_x, coordinate_y, coordinate_z, bank, bay, level, location_type, enabled, is_occupied, is_locked, is_reserved, lock_reason, preferred_status, created_time, updated_time
mapper.update: UPDATE location_point SET is_occupied = #{flag}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM location_point WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM location_point WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('Transfer#', #{transferId}, '%') AND enabled = 'Y'
SELECT id FROM location_point WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('Gripper#', #{gripperId}, '%') AND enabled = 'Y'

SELECT lp.code AS location_code, lp.name AS location_name, lp.zone_code, lp.location_type, -- 帳籍佔用狀態：有 tracking（帳上有掛容器）為 'ON'，無則 'OFF' CASE WHEN lt.id IS NULL THEN 'OFF' ELSE 'ON' END AS slot_present_status, IF(lp.is_locked='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_locked, IF(lp.is_reserved='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_reserved, IF(lp.is_occupied='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_occupied, -- 物理旗標 cm.alias_code AS container_alias_code, cm.container_type, cm.container_code, cm.lot_no, cm.part_no, cd.estimated_quantity, cd.verified_quantity, cd.ocr_text1, cd.ocr_text2, lt.arrived_time FROM location_point lp LEFT JOIN location_tracking lt ON lp.id = lt.location_point_id LEFT JOIN container_main cm ON lt.container_main_id = cm.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cdata.* FROM container_data cdata INNER JOIN ( SELECT container_main_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM container_data GROUP BY container_main_id ) last ON cdata.container_main_id = last.container_main_id AND cdata.id = last.max_id ) cd ON cm.id = cd.container_main_id WHERE lp.location_type = 'STORAGE' AND lp.enabled = 'Y' ORDER BY lp.code

SELECT lp.code AS location_code, lp.name AS location_name, lp.zone_code, lp.location_type, CASE WHEN lt.id IS NULL THEN 'OFF' ELSE 'ON' END AS slot_present_status, IF(lp.is_locked='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_locked, IF(lp.is_reserved='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_reserved, IF(lp.is_occupied='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_occupied, cm.alias_code AS container_alias_code, cm.container_type, cm.container_code, cm.lot_no, cm.part_no, cd.estimated_quantity, cd.verified_quantity, cd.ocr_text1, cd.ocr_text2, lt.arrived_time FROM location_point lp LEFT JOIN location_tracking lt ON lp.id = lt.location_point_id LEFT JOIN container_main cm ON lt.container_main_id = cm.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cdata.* FROM container_data cdata INNER JOIN ( SELECT container_main_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM container_data GROUP BY container_main_id ) last ON cdata.container_main_id = last.container_main_id AND cdata.id = last.max_id ) cd ON cm.id = cd.container_main_id WHERE lp.location_type = 'STORAGE' AND lp.enabled = 'Y' AND lp.zone_code = #{zoneCode} ORDER BY lp.code

SELECT lp.code AS location_code, lp.name AS location_name, lp.zone_code, lp.location_type, CASE WHEN lt.id IS NULL THEN 'OFF' ELSE 'ON' END AS slot_present_status, IF(lp.is_locked='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_locked, IF(lp.is_reserved='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_reserved, IF(lp.is_occupied='Y', TRUE, FALSE) AS is_occupied, cm.alias_code AS container_alias_code, cm.container_type, cm.container_code, cm.lot_no, cm.part_no, cd.estimated_quantity, cd.verified_quantity, cd.ocr_text1, cd.ocr_text2, lt.arrived_time FROM location_point lp LEFT JOIN location_tracking lt ON lp.id = lt.location_point_id LEFT JOIN container_main cm ON lt.container_main_id = cm.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cdata.* FROM container_data cdata INNER JOIN ( SELECT container_main_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM container_data GROUP BY container_main_id ) last ON cdata.container_main_id = last.container_main_id AND cdata.id = last.max_id ) cd ON cm.id = cd.container_main_id WHERE lp.location_type = 'STORAGE' AND lp.enabled = 'Y' AND ( (lt.id IS NULL AND lp.is_occupied = 'Y') -- 帳籍沒容器但感測有貨 OR (lt.id IS NOT NULL AND lp.is_occupied = 'N') -- 帳籍有容器但感測沒貨 ) ORDER BY lp.code
